verdict.rationale: A government online-services provider could plausibly publish developer SDKs or APIs, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web applications (UTR, UTS) and a desktop QuickFile tool for uploading formatted wage files, which is an adjacent feature, not an SDK. Probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
